model: finite-dimensional closed pure-state qubit chain with sequential tensor-factor emission
claim_ceiling: This is a U(1)-conserving quantum-circuit toy model. It is not Hawking radiation, a gravitational evaporation calculation, a Page-island derivation, or evidence for a four-dimensional black-hole information solution.

conventions.initial_state: Haar-random pure state restricted to the exact Hamming-weight-k (fixed-N) subspace

each_emission_step: Apply a seeded Haar element of U(1) x U(2) x U(1) to the first two active black-hole qubits.
Move the first active tensor factor into the collected radiation register.
Never apply any later gate to an emitted tensor factor.
evolution.final_single_qubit: The final active qubit is transferred without another two-qubit gate.
evolution.gate_family: Block diagonal in pair excitation sectors: a phase on |00>, a Haar U(2) on span{|01>,|10>}, and a phase on |11>.
evolution.state_representation: One full 2^N pure-state vector with an explicit B/R partition; emission is a factor relabelling after a unitary boundary interaction.

reference_controls.expected: zero entanglement at every cut; N expectation 0; variance 0
zero entanglement at every cut; N expectation 6; variance 0
all matrix elements between different pair-excitation sectors vanish; U dagger U = identity; [U,N_pair] = 0
S(R) = S(B) at each emission step within independently declared numerical tolerance
after the final factor transfer, the collected radiation is the full pure state; entropy 0 and purity 1

benchmark_case.purpose: finite-size sequential boundary-emission trajectory with charge conservation and independent B/R entropy comparison

resource_limits.note: The bound ensures both sides of every nontrivial bipartition fit the current dense reduced-density-matrix backend.

negative_controls: replace a U(1)-conserving gate with an unrestricted Haar U(4) gate
apply a gate to a previously emitted radiation qubit
prepare a state with support outside the declared excitation sector
renormalize an evolved state after a deliberately non-unitary perturbation
report a Page-island or Hawking result from this circuit

required_receipt.ci_policy: queued, missing, or skipped checks are not passes
